inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A child's diaper was changed, but their hands were not washed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: On the playground, grass was growing through the mulch, two ant piles were observed, and a trash can with trash without a lid was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: A fire drill was not conducted for the month of July. This was corrected at inspection when a fire drill was conducted with appropriate exit times.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep: Three children's heads were covered during naptime. This was corrected at inspection when the children's heads were uncovered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §746.2905(1))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: The operation informed Child Care Regulation on 9/1/26 that they were unaware of a person who had a background check under this operation. The operation was notified to background check is still active.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Two children did not have the required medication per their allergy response plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child did not have an up to date immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation failed to meet one condition of probation.   One employee completed abuse/neglect training and had the post training meeting however the post training meeting occurred prior to the employee completing the abuse/neglect training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: One caregiver was present at the operation without an active background check. This was corrected when the operation sent the caregiver home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation did not meet one of the probation condition. A caregiver did not have a review of updated reporting policies completed within 7 days of employment or before having access to children. The operation held the policy meeting with CCR present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation did not meet one of the probation condition. A caregiver did not have a review of updated reporting policies completed within 7 days of employment or before having access to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A classroom had an age gap of 23 months between the youngest and the oldest child. This was corrected at inspection when the operation moved the two oldest children to the next classroom, making the age gap 15 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: When the audit was completed the operation failed to document the required items that were missing or needed corrections.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation did not meet two of the probation conditions. A required Weekly Health and Safety Checklist was not found for one week. A post-training meeting was not held 10 days after the operation attended a required probation training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation failed to follow two probation conditions. The operation is required to implement updated policies regarding incident report and review the policies with employees. This was not completed. The operation is required to create and submit a plan to audit staff files. This was not completed or submitted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One child did not have up to date written feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: One child did not have the medication required per their allergy plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: One caregiver did not have completed 24 hours of annual training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based: One staff member completed CPR online and did not complete the hands-on portion of the training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Records-Available During Business Hours: Two staff members did not have a copy of their cpr/first aid cards available for review. The operation supplied one caregiver's CPR/first aid card but did not send the remaining two.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Records-Available During Business Hours (26 TAC §746.805(3))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Fire drills were not completed for the month of August.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Grass, weeds, and sticker burrs were growing on the playground in areas where children were playing. The operation did not meet the agreed upon compliance date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Electronic Records-Available During Business Hours: Two staff members did not have a copy of their cpr/first aid cards available for review. The operation supplied one caregiver's CPR/first aid card but did not send the remaining two.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Records-Available During Business Hours (26 TAC §746.805(3))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Records-Available During Business Hours: Three staff members did not have a copy of their cpr/first aid cards available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Records-Available During Business Hours (26 TAC §746.805(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours: Personnel training records were not available for review during inspection and were not sent when requested by CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records -Training Hours (26 TAC §746.901(6))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: Smoke and carbon monoxide detectors were not checked for the month of June.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Grass, weeds, and sticker burrs were growing on the playground in areas where children were playing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: A caregiver failed to report concerns of a child placed at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation waited 10 days before making a self-report that a child was placed at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation did not notify Child Care Regulation within the required two days when a child was placed at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: There was peeling paint and missing baseboards observed during an investigation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: During a DFPS investigation, there was sufficient evidence to support that a caregiver abused a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed: An incident report was not completed or provided to the parent of a child that was injured while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed (26 TAC §746.705)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers-Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation: The operation waited 3 weeks before reporting suspected child abuse by a caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers-Report Suspected Child Abuse, Neglect or Exploitation (26 TAC §746.1201(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: During a DFPS investigation there is sufficient evidence to support that a caregiver choked a child around the neck.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: One employee did not have an active background check and was present at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): One caregiver did not have a completed affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Controlling Person: The director was not named as controlling person and their controlling person form was not received by Child Care Regulation. The director has been present since the end of September 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Controlling Person (26 TAC §746.305(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: Carbon monoxide detectors had not been checked monthly and recorded.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: There was no fire drill completed for the month of October.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Director: The director present during the inspection was not listed as director. Additionally, Child Care Regulation had not received her director's credentials. The director listed had not been present since June of 2024 and two people had filled the position since then, Child Care Regulation did not receive notification for the two directors named since June of 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §746.303(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: 4 caregivers did not have active CPR or First Aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Through interviews with staff and parents, it was found that a caregiver was yelling and using a loud voice with children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired: The first aid kit contained expired antiseptic and expired eye wash.     This was corrected at inspection when the director threw the expired items away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Supplies Not Expired (26 TAC §746.4003(b))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Out 6 personnel records reviewed, 1 did not have food allergy training and 1 did not have hazardous materials trainings that are required annually.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Out of six records reviewed, two infant's feeding instructions signed by the parent were unavailable at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Out of six files reviewed, it was stated one caregiver took CPR/1st Aid training recently but did not have proof at inspection. The most recent certificate available at inspection expired on 8/24/23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: It was observed that the last fire drill was completed in September 2022.  A fire drill will be conducted and documented by the end of the week.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: The most recent fire inspection was not available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There were no signed infant feeding instructions to review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument: Information obtained during the investigation shows that a caregiver used their hand to slap a child on the face.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument (26 TAC §746.2805(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Information obtained during the investigation shows that a child was physically abused by a caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: During the investigation it was found that the operation did not immediately communicate with parent about a situation that placed a child at risk.     Discussed with the operation the importance of communicating with parents as soon as possible about a situation that has placed a child at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Have Access to Tracking System: During the investigation it was determine that each caregiver did not have access to tracking system to account for children in care.       This was corrected as the operation has implemented a system to ensure all caregivers have access to a tracking system to account for each child in care that they are working with.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Have Access to Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(b))
